answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 46003 Country: India Title: Should one read Bismillahir rahmanir rahim before each and every thing in namaz. Question: Should one read Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim before everything in salah like before sana, Surah Fatiha, qirah, attahiyat, durood and dua in all the rakahs. Please answer in English. Answer ID: 46003 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 923/707/D=1434) No, you should recite Sana after takbir tahrimah and then read اعوذ بالله من الشيطن الرجيم and then بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم i.e. read them before Surah Fatiha. Do not read it before durood, dua or sana etc as it is not proved. Clarification: However, if someone is muqtadi i.e. he is offering salah behind any imam then he should only read sana not اعوذ بالله من الشيطن الرجيم and بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم. (L) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
